title: GetReplacementDetailsResponse
description: Information about a replacement device, including the original device it replaces and the date the replacement occurred.

serial_number.description: The serial number of the replacement device.

original_device_serial_number.description: The serial number of the original device that this device replaces.

replacement_date.description: The date when the device replacement occurred, in ISO 8601 format with day granularity in UTC (for example, `2025-01-15`).
replacement_date.$comment: Despite describing ISO 8601 we use `date` as the format type rather than `date-time` per the other qualifier of 'day granularity.'
